title: Student Union Election Link
scenario: A campaign DM asks you to log in through a short link to vote.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Student Union Election Link: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Campus voting uses official university channels.
